note: Ground truth for OWASP Juice Shop 20.3.0, generated by benchmark/real/juice-key.mjs from the release's own coding-challenge markers (vuln-line comments) and data/static/challenges.yml; do not edit by hand, regenerate. Never copy this file into the audited directory. One entry per group of challenges whose vulnerable lines overlap; locations are files relative to the release root (the run's app/) with 1-based inclusive line ranges. fetch.mjs blanks the marker comments in app/ without removing lines, so these numbers hold there. Juice Shop has no severities: difficulty (1 to 6) is the game's own rating, not a risk score. Only challenges with a coding challenge are keyed (33 of 116); the others have no marked line and are not scored, so findings about them are unmatched, not false positives. Same format and matching rules as benchmark/answer-key.json.
